zh.title: 视觉小说模式
zh.text:
点顶栏的「视觉小说」，最新一条回复就变成游戏画面：场景做背景，说话的人站在前面，名字栏、打字机，一句一句往下读。
开关按角色卡记住；发给模型的内容一字不改，缓存不受影响。

en.title: Visual novel mode
en.text:
Switch on Visual novel in the top bar and the latest reply plays like a game: the scene behind, whoever speaks in front, a name plate and typewriter text, one line at a time.
Remembered per card; what the model is sent never changes, so the cache is untouched.

zh.title: 每个人都有立绘
zh.text:
谁说话谁站出来，旁白时退下。配图名单里白底的人设图自动抠图、描白边；没有能用的就按长相画一张半身立绘。
说话人自动认出来——连「她说」「掌柜的愣了一下」这种也认得；名字栏按人分颜色，对白和旁白分开上色。

en.title: A sprite for everyone
en.text:
Whoever speaks steps forward; during narration they step back. White-background reference pictures in the cast list are cut out and outlined; anyone without one gets a half-body sprite drawn from their looks.
Speakers are told even from "she said" or a nameless innkeeper; each name plate has its own colour, and dialogue is coloured apart from narration.

zh.title: 场景图
zh.text:
故事到了新地点，自动画一张没有人物的场景当背景，存在这张卡下面，下次到同一个地方直接用。也可以「画这一轮的场景」，按这一轮写的样子画。
傍晚、夜里、雨、雪用色调和动画表现，不用重画。

en.title: Scenes
en.text:
When the story reaches a new place, an empty scene is drawn for it as the background, kept with the card and reused whenever the story returns. Or draw this turn's scene, as the reply describes it.
Dusk, night, rain and snow are tints and animations over it, not new pictures.

zh.title: 像游戏一样选
zh.text:
读到最后，行动选项在画面中央弹出来，按 1–4 直接选，✎ 先改再发，也可以自己写。
还有回看、自动、跳过、全屏（F）、逐句朗读，一条回复中途换地点时背景也跟着换。

en.title: Choose like in a game
en.text:
At the end of a reply the choices open in the middle of the picture: press 1–4 to pick, ✎ to edit one first, or write your own.
Also: backlog, auto, skip, full screen (F), line-by-line reading, and the background follows the story when it moves on halfway through a reply.

zh.title: 导入 SillyTavern 的对话
zh.text:
把 SillyTavern 的对话记录（.jsonl）拖进窗口，或者在角色卡下点「导入存档」：每一轮、每个 swipe、MVU 变量都带过来。
很长的对话可以先压缩成剧情存档，之后只发存档和最近两轮，原文都还在。

en.title: Import SillyTavern chats
en.text:
Drop a SillyTavern chat (.jsonl) into the window, or use Import archive under a card: every turn, every swipe and the MVU variables come with it.
A long one can be compacted into a story archive first, so each turn sends only the archive and the last two turns; the full text stays.

zh.title: 手机添加到主屏幕
zh.text:
开着「手机访问」时，iPhone 用 Safari、安卓用 Chrome 打开链接，添加到主屏幕后像 App 一样全屏打开，不用再输口令。
朗读的控制条也变成了输入框上方的小胶囊，不再挡住输入框。

en.title: On your phone's home screen
en.text:
With phone access on, open the link in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android) and add it to the home screen: it opens full screen like an app, no key to type again.
The read-aloud controls are now a small pill above the input instead of a bar over it.

zh.title: 每个角色有自己的音色
zh.text:
在「配图与朗读 → 朗读 → 音色」里，给角色名册里的每个人选一个音色，没选的用对白音色。
视觉小说模式按每句的说话人读；普通模式点「朗读」或点一句对白也一样，两个人挨着说的话不再连成一段。

en.title: A voice for each character
en.text:
In Pictures & voice → Voice → Voices, give everyone in the cast a voice of their own; anyone without one takes the dialogue voice.
Visual novel mode reads each line in its speaker's voice, and so do Read aloud and clicking a line; two people's lines next to each other are no longer read as one.

zh.title: 视觉小说里直接改设置
zh.text:
右上角「朗读」「配图」旁边的 ▾：逐句朗读、自动翻页、各人的音色、朗读模型；新回复自动配图、场景和立绘怎么画、画图方式和模型、画幅。
改了马上保存，「更多…」打开完整的设置。

en.title: Settings right in the visual novel
en.text:
The ▾ beside Read and Pictures at the top right: line-by-line reading, auto-advance, everyone's voice and the voice model; pictures for new replies, how scenes and sprites are drawn, the image backend, model and shape.
Changes save at once; More… opens the full settings.

zh.title: CG 回廊
zh.text:
右上角「CG」或按 G：这条故事线上所有的配图，标着是开场还是第几轮。
点一张全屏看，← → 翻遍所有 CG，Esc 回到回廊。

en.title: CG gallery
en.text:
CG at the top right, or G: every picture on this storyline, each marked with its turn.
Open one full size, ← → go through all of them, Esc goes back to the gallery.

zh.title: 更多画图方式和音色
zh.text:
新增 Gemini 原生生图（Nano Banana，能照人设图画）、本地的 SD WebUI / Forge，OpenRouter 的出图模型也能用了；朗读多了 Gemini 的 30 个音色。Gemini 用「Gemini」模板建的供应商，和对话共用密钥。
还没设好的画图方式和朗读来源，会在「配图与朗读」里标出来。

en.title: More ways to draw and to speak
en.text:
New: Gemini's own image models (Nano Banana, following reference pictures), local SD WebUI / Forge, and OpenRouter's image models; Gemini's 30 voices for reading aloud. Gemini uses the provider made from the Gemini template, the same key as chat.
An image backend or voice source that isn't set up yet now stands out in Pictures & voice.

zh.title: 名字栏更准
zh.text:
冒号前的叙述（「嘴角翘起来：」「笑得很短：」）不再被当成人名，「柏木绾追问」「顾言如实说」这类认得出名字；刚打开一张卡时，第一句的名字栏也不会错。
另外修了：视觉小说里选完选项后，输入框只剩一条缝。

en.title: Sharper name plates
en.text:
Narration before a colon is no longer taken for a name, and more ways of naming who speaks are understood; the first line's plate is right when a card has just opened.
Also fixed: the input box shrinking to a sliver after a choice in visual novel mode.

zh.title: 世界书条目可以查看和修改
zh.text:
设置 →「挂载的世界书」→「查看条目」：卡里自带的和导入的世界书逐条列出，可以搜索、开关，改名字、触发方式、关键词、位置、顺序和内容，改了自动保存。
常驻条目写在对话开局的固定前缀里，进行中的对话要「应用到当前对话」才会用上；关键词条目下一轮就生效。

en.title: View and edit lorebook entries
en.text:
Settings → Attached lorebooks → View entries: a card's own lorebook and the imported ones, entry by entry. Search them, switch them on or off, and edit the name, trigger, keywords, position, order and text; changes save at once.
Always-on entries live in the fixed prefix written when a chat starts, so a chat under way picks them up after Apply to this chat; keyword entries take effect on the next turn.

zh.title: 手机上的视觉小说
zh.text:
右上角只留一行按钮，其余收进「⋯」；「朗读」「配图」旁的 ▾ 从屏幕底部弹出，人多也能滚到底。
选项排在控制栏和文本框之间，长选项也能完整显示；手机横过来时，左边的角色卡栏收起。

en.title: Visual novel mode on phones
en.text:
One row of buttons at the top right, the rest behind ⋯; the ▾ beside Read and Pictures opens as a sheet from the bottom that scrolls however long the cast is.
The choices fit between the buttons and the text box, long ones included; held sideways, the card list steps aside.

zh.title: 名字栏更准
zh.text:
角色名册没写性别时，也能从回复里推断「他」「她」是谁；两人一来一回说话时，单独一句引号认得出是谁说的；「他听见她说」归给「她」。
另外，设置里的「配图与朗读」单独成了一组，不用再去「更多」里找。

en.title: Sharper name plates
en.text:
With no genders in the cast list, "he" and "she" are worked out from the reply; when two people trade lines, a lone quote goes to the right one; "he heard her say" goes to her.
Also: Pictures & voice is a group of its own in Settings instead of a row under More.

zh.title: 修改角色卡
zh.text:
角色卡的「⋯ → 修改角色卡」：名字、描述、开场白、世界书这些都能直接改，改了存进这张卡，对话和名册都不变。
也可以在右边用对话修改：说说想怎么改，模型把每一处改前改后标出来，勾选的才会用上。

en.title: Edit a card
en.text:
A card's ⋯ → Edit card: change the name, description, greetings, lorebook and the rest in place; it saves into the card, and its chats and cast stay as they are.
Or edit by chat on the right: say what to change, and each change is shown before and after, applied only if ticked.

zh.title: 生成头像，每次画图都能选方式
zh.text:
修改角色卡里点「生成头像」，按卡里的角色画一张方形头像，满意了再换上。
生成头像、名册的「画一张」、配图的「重画」和「换个画法…」都能临时选这一张用哪种画图方式和模型，不改设置。

en.title: Generate an avatar, pick how each picture is drawn
en.text:
In Edit card, Generate avatar draws a square avatar of the card's character, put on only when you take it.
Generate avatar, the cast's Draw one, and Redraw or Draw it differently… under a picture can each pick the image backend and model for that one picture, without changing your settings.

zh.title: 手机上的应用内更新
zh.text:
设置 → 更多 → 更新 →「下载并安装」：在应用里下载，断网了接着下；核对 SHA-256 和签名后直接打开系统的安装界面，点「更新」就好，数据保留。
第一次会先打开「安装未知应用」的设置，打开开关后返回会接着安装。

en.title: In-app updates on the phone
en.text:
Settings → More → Updates → Download and install: the app downloads it, picking up where a dropped connection left off, checks the SHA-256 and signature, then opens the system installer; tap Update and your data stays.
The first time, it opens the Install unknown apps setting: turn it on and come back, and the install carries on.

zh.title: 视觉小说：多人同屏、表情和演出
zh.text:
场景里说话的人一起站在台上（电脑最多三个，手机两个），说话的亮起，其余的暗下去；叙述里写了离开或者换了地点就退场。
「立绘」窗口里可以给每个角色画一套表情，每句按叙述换；闪电、巨响时画面闪白或震动。

en.title: Visual novel: several on stage, expressions and effects
en.text:
The people in a scene stand on stage together (up to three on a computer, two on a phone): the speaker lit, the rest dimmed, stepping off when the narration has them leave or the place changes.
In the Sprites window each character can get a set of expressions, picked line by line from the narration; lightning or a crash flashes or shakes the picture.

zh.title: 存档和读档
zh.text:
视觉小说模式右上角的「存档」「读档」：每张卡 18 个存档位、一个快速存档（F5 存、F9 读）和每轮自动存的最近十个。
读档回到存档的那一句接着玩，之后写过的收起来保留成分支，不会删掉。

en.title: Save and load
en.text:
Save and Load at the top right of visual novel mode: 18 slots for each card, a quick save (F5 to save, F9 to load) and the last ten turns saved on their own.
Loading picks up at the saved line; whatever was written after it is kept as a branch, not deleted.

zh.title: 世界书管理
zh.text:
角色卡列表上方的「世界书」，或 设置 → 世界书与状态 →「管理世界书」：导入的每本世界书都能改名、写备注、导出、复制、删除，一次勾选挂在哪些卡上，还能单独设扫描深度。
「多选」可以一次启用、停用、删除条目，或者复制、移动到另一本。

en.title: Manage lorebooks
en.text:
Lorebook beside the card list's heading, or Settings → Lorebooks & state → Manage lorebooks: rename, note, export, duplicate or delete each imported lorebook, tick the cards it's attached to in one place, and give it its own scan depth.
Select enables, disables or deletes several entries at once, or copies or moves them to another lorebook.

zh.title: 对话修改：世界书、预设、正则和主题
zh.text:
这四个窗口都有了「对话修改」：说想怎么改，向导把要改的地方整条写出来，改前改后对照着看，勾上的才改进去，刚采用的还能撤销。
空白的世界书说一句想法就写出一整本；正则先拿最新回复试一遍再给你看；主题配好浅色和深色两套，能先在界面上预览。

en.title: Edit by chat: lorebooks, presets, regex and the theme
en.text:
All four windows now have Edit by chat: say what to change, and the guide writes out each piece it would change, before and after side by side; only what you tick goes in, and the last change can be undone.
An empty lorebook can be written from one sentence; regex is tried on the latest reply before you see it; the theme comes as a light and a dark set you can preview on the page first.

zh.title: 自定义配色、字体字号、搜索和全局世界书
zh.text:
「主题」里有了自定义配色（十二个颜色逐个调）和故事正文的字体、字号；角色卡列表和世界书都能搜索，世界书还能设成全局，所有对话都用。
另外，配图里一定会有人物，开场白多的卡也能一条条看清再选。

en.title: Custom colours, font and size, search, global lorebooks
en.text:
Theme now has custom colours (twelve, each adjustable) and the story's font and size; the card list and the lorebooks can be searched, and a lorebook can be made global for every chat.
Also: pictures always have someone in them, and a card with many openings shows each one in full before you pick.

zh.title: 视觉小说模式（1.8 起）
zh.text:
点顶栏的「视觉小说」，回复变成一句一句读的游戏画面：说话的人站上台、带着表情，几个人可以同屏；到了新地点自动画一张场景当背景，配图都收进 CG 回廊；每个角色有自己的音色，还能存档读档。
只改显示，发给模型的内容一字不改。

en.title: Visual novel mode (since 1.8)
en.text:
Turn on "Visual novel" in the top bar and replies play like a game, a line at a time: whoever speaks steps on stage with an expression, several at once; a new place gets a scene drawn behind it, and every picture goes into the CG gallery; each character can have their own voice, and you can save and load.
Only the display changes; what goes to the model stays word for word.

zh.title: 1.8 的其他更新
zh.text:
修改角色卡、生成头像；世界书逐条修改和整本管理；导入 SillyTavern 的对话；手机添加到主屏幕，安卓在应用里下载更新；画图多了 Gemini、SD WebUI 和 OpenRouter。
想看每一版的详细介绍，点上面的「CicaTavern 1.9」换到 1.8。

en.title: More from 1.8
en.text:
Edit a card and generate its avatar; edit lorebook entries and manage whole lorebooks; import SillyTavern chats; add the app to your phone's home screen, and on Android download updates in the app; draw with Gemini, SD WebUI or OpenRouter.
For each version's own pages, pick 1.8 from "CicaTavern 1.9" above.

zh.title: 视觉小说：HUD、换天和回忆
zh.text:
画面左上角常驻几个变量（好感、体力、金钱……点一下选显示哪些，显示成条、数字还是图标）；读到一轮的结尾，下面弹出「好感 +5」「获得：旧信」。
日期往后走时画面中间出现「第 N 天」，回忆的段落画面泛黄。

en.title: Visual novel: a HUD, new days and memories
en.text:
A few variables stay at the top left (affection, stamina, money…; click it to choose which, each as a bar, a number or an icon); at the end of a turn, notes like "Affection +5" and "Got: old letter" pop up under it.
When the date moves on, "Day N" crosses the picture, and memories turn sepia.

zh.title: 补写变量、选项按钮和表情包
zh.text:
MVU 卡的回复漏了变量更新块时，点「补写变量」只补那一块；卡和预设自己的行动选项（「探索选项」「请选择你的下一步行动」这类）也变成能点的按钮。
「立绘」里能导入 SillyTavern 的表情包，「角色名册」能从对话里补上后来出场的角色。

en.title: Write variables, choice buttons and expression packs
en.text:
When an MVU card's reply leaves out its variable update, "Write variables" writes just that block; a card's or preset's own action options become buttons too.
Sprites can import a SillyTavern expression pack, and the cast list can add the characters who joined later, from the chat.

zh.title: 视觉小说：模型标出谁在说话
zh.text:
视觉小说里，模型会在每句台词前标上说话人和表情（标记本身不显示），名字栏、立绘和表情都按标的来，不用再从叙述里猜；遇到冲击、雷电还能标上震屏、闪白。
用基础预设时默认开；用导入的预设时在「立绘 → 对白标注」里打开。只加在每轮的消息里，开关不影响缓存。

en.title: Visual novel: the model marks who is speaking
en.text:
In the visual novel mode the model marks who says each line and how they look (the marks are not shown), so the name plate, the sprite and the expression follow them instead of a guess from the narration; it can also ask for a shake or a flash.
On by default with the built-in preset; with an imported one, turn it on in Sprites → Mark speakers. It rides on each turn's message only, so switching it costs no cache.

zh.title: 国内更新镜像和修复
zh.text:
检查更新时 GitHub 连不上或迟迟不回应，会改从国内镜像（cnb.cool）取版本信息和安装包，带签名校验，从下一次更新起用得上。
修复：回复结尾有一长串 ** 装饰时打开对话会卡住；视觉小说边写边读时会被拉回前面一句、来回循环。

en.title: An update mirror in China, and fixes
en.text:
When GitHub cannot be reached for an update, or takes too long, the app turns to a mirror in China (cnb.cool) for the release and the package, with a signature check; it helps from the next update on.
Fixed: a chat froze when a reply ended on a long run of ** decorations; reading a visual novel reply while it was written kept jumping back to an earlier line.

zh.title: 角色卡里的界面能做更多事
zh.text:
为酒馆助手做的界面（开局页、战斗、小游戏）现在能调用模型（每张卡第一次先问你）、读写世界书（只改这个对话）、保存聊天变量、往对话里加或删消息。
EJS 模板按提示词模板插件补齐：setvar 写的变量会保存，条目开头的 @@if 等装饰器生效，显示正则里的 <%= getvar(…) %> 会显示成那一楼的数值；检测「提示词模板」的卡会看到它开着。

en.title: Card UIs can do more
en.text:
UIs built for Tavern Helper (start pages, battles, mini games) can now call the model (each card asks you first), read and write lorebooks (for this chat only), keep chat variables, and add or remove messages.
EJS templates follow the Prompt Template plugin more fully: setvar writes are kept, decorators such as @@if work, and <%= getvar(…) %> in a display regex shows that message's value; cards that check for Prompt Template find it.

zh.title: 错误日志和角色名册
zh.text:
出了问题时，「设置 → 更多 → 错误日志」（出错的提示条上也有）可以复制或存下一份报告发给开发者，里面没有对话内容，密钥、令牌和用户名都去掉了，只存在你自己的设备上。
角色名册人多时更好找：收成一行一个、可以搜索；「从对话里补充」认得外号和写错的名字。卡里自带的世界书可以导出或抽成单独的一本。

en.title: An error log, and the cast list
en.text:
When something goes wrong, Settings → More → Error log (also on the error's notice) copies or saves a report to send to the developer: no chat text, with keys, tokens and your user name taken out, and it stays on your device.
The cast list is easier with many characters: one row each, with search; Add from the chat knows nicknames and misspelled names. A card's own lorebook can be exported or copied out as a book of its own.

zh.title: 联网搜索
zh.text:
输入框左边多了一个地球图标，按对话开关。打开后，需要时事、真实地点和人物、作品资料这类现实世界的信息时，模型先搜网页再写，正文里不提搜索；回复下面可以展开看搜了什么、引用了哪些网页。
用供应商自己的搜索：Anthropic 接口的 Claude、OpenAI Responses 接口、OpenRouter 的模型可以用，搜索按次另外收费。

en.title: Web search
en.text:
A globe left of the input box turns web search on for a chat. When real-world facts are needed (news, real places and people, details of a work), the model searches first and keeps the search out of the story; what it searched for and the pages it cited unfold under the reply.
It uses the provider's own search: Claude on the Anthropic interface, the OpenAI Responses interface and OpenRouter models have it. Searches cost extra.

zh.title: 卡片界面连不上自己的接口时
zh.text: 有的大型卡在界面里自带 API 设置（比如角色创建界面），浏览器直接连你填的地址时常出现「Failed to fetch」。现在连不上时会问一次：改由 CicaTavern 替它连接吗？同意后这张卡连这个地址就经应用发出，走应用的网络代理，流式回复照样逐字到达。

en.title: When a card UI cannot reach its own API
en.text: Some big cards have their own API settings in their UI (a character creator, say), and the browser calling the address you typed often ends in "Failed to fetch". Now, when that happens, the app asks once whether CicaTavern should make the call for it; once you agree, that card reaches that address through the app and its network proxy, and streamed replies still arrive as they are written.

zh.title: 屏蔽词
zh.text:
「设置 → 写作 → 屏蔽词」，一份列表管所有对话。每个词可以去掉、遮成 * 或换成你自选的词，可以只改显示、只改发给模型的，或者两个都改；「更多」里有区分大小写、整词和例外。
存下来的原文不变，关掉或删掉就恢复；同一份列表每轮发出的内容一样，照常命中缓存。下面有试一试的框，拿当前对话的最新回复看换完的样子。

en.title: Blocked words
en.text:
Settings → Writing → Blocked words: one list for every chat. Each word can be removed, masked with * or swapped for one you choose, in what is shown, what is sent to the model, or both; More has case, whole words and exceptions.
The stored text never changes, so switching a word off or deleting it brings it back, and the same list sends the same text every turn, so the cache still hits. A try-it box below shows the open chat's latest reply with the list applied.

zh.title: 卡片界面权限
zh.text:
卡片界面（回复里卡片自带的网页界面）不经你点击、自己把输入框里的内容发出去，以前不会问；现在每张卡第一次这样做时问你一次。在卡片界面里点它的按钮发送算你自己发的，不用问。
自己调用模型、经 CicaTavern 联网也是每张卡问一次，现在「不允许」也会记住。想改的话，在角色卡菜单里点「卡片界面权限…」。

en.title: Card UI permissions
en.text:
A card's UI (the web page a card draws in its replies) could send what was in the input box without your click, and nothing asked; now each card asks the first time it does. Sending with one of its buttons is you sending, so that is never asked.
Calling the model and going online through CicaTavern also ask once per card, and now a no is kept as well. To change an answer, open Card UI permissions… in the card's menu.

zh.title: 更稳，也更像 SillyTavern
zh.text:
修了一批会让服务卡住或退出的情况（会无限回溯的正则、几千亿个骰子、能解压成几百 MB 的图片）和同时保存时互相覆盖、写坏文件的问题；安卓版重启后不再丢页面里存的东西（主题、卡片界面权限），网页崩了也能重新打开。
多条 initvar、正则里的 $0 和 {{match}}、预设里的 {{description}} 这类卡片字段，现在和 SillyTavern 读法一样。

en.title: Steadier, and closer to SillyTavern
en.text:
Fixed a set of ways the server could hang or quit (runaway regex, billions of dice, an image that inflates to hundreds of MB) and saves at the same time overwriting each other or breaking a file; the Android app keeps what its page saved (the theme, card UI permissions) across restarts and reopens after its web view crashes.
Several initvar entries, $0 and {{match}} in regex, and card fields such as {{description}} in presets now read as they do in SillyTavern.

zh.title: 语音输入
zh.text:
输入框右边多了一个麦克风：点一下开始说，再点一下转成文字，填进输入框，看过再自己发送。
不用安装任何东西：可以用供应商的转写接口（硅基流动 SenseVoice 免费），或电脑浏览器自带的识别；也能接自己装的 whisper 服务。在「配图与朗读 → 语音输入」里选，CicaTavern 不保存录音。

en.title: Voice input
en.text:
A microphone beside the input box: tap to speak, tap again and the words land in the box for you to read and send.
Nothing to install: a provider's transcription API (SiliconFlow's SenseVoice is free) or the desktop browser's own recognition, or a whisper server of your own. Choose in Pictures & voice → Voice input; CicaTavern keeps no recordings.

zh.title: 重画了也能换回来
zh.text:
配图、人设图、立绘和表情、场景图、卡的头像重画之后，旧的不丢：每处留最近几张，排在下面一行小图，点一张换回来用，不要的点 × 删掉。
留几张在「配图与朗读 → 画图方式」里改，默认 5 张。

en.title: Redraw, then take the old one back
en.text:
Illustrations, reference pictures, sprites and expressions, scenes and a card's avatar keep their last few versions after a redraw, in a row of thumbnails below: tap one to use it again, or × to delete it.
How many to keep is in Pictures & voice → Drawing (5 by default).

zh.title: 正则集、你的角色和文风，按卡指定
zh.text:
正则窗口改成和世界书一样，能复制、导出成 SillyTavern 的正则文件；还可以建自己的正则集，只挂到选中的几张卡上。
「你的角色」和「文风」变成列表，能复制、导入导出 SillyTavern 的格式，每张卡可以各指定一个，没指定的用默认的。

en.title: Regex sets, personas and styles, per card
en.text:
The regex window now works like the lorebook one, with copies and SillyTavern exports, and you can make regex sets that run only on the cards you attach them to.
Your personas and writing styles are lists with copies and SillyTavern imports and exports, and each card can pick one of each; the rest use the default.

zh.title: 1.9 加了什么
zh.text: 对话修改世界书、预设、正则和主题，自定义配色和正文字体；视觉小说的 HUD、换天、回忆和对白标注；卡片界面能调用模型、读写世界书，EJS 模板按提示词模板插件补齐；联网搜索、屏蔽词、错误日志，以及国内更新镜像。

en.title: What 1.9 added
en.text: Editing lorebooks, presets, regex and the theme by chat, custom colours and story fonts; the visual novel HUD, new days, memories and speaker marks; card UIs that call the model and edit lorebooks, and EJS templates that follow the Prompt Template plugin; web search, blocked words, an error log, and an update mirror in China.

zh.title: 上下文压缩，更自由也更省心
zh.text:
顶栏「压缩上下文」旁能看到这段对话用了多少上下文、离上限还有多远。到哪个比例整理成剧情存档、最多多少 token、是直接整理还是先提醒你，都在「设置 → 模型 → 上下文压缩」里按自己的习惯调；模型的上限会自动认出来，也可以自己填。
点「压缩上下文」时可以挑一个模型来写存档；故事太长、一个模型读不下时，会给出换模型或只保留最近两轮的办法，不会卡住。

en.title: Context compaction, your way
en.text:
Beside Compact context in the top bar you can see how much of the model's context a chat uses and how far it is from the limit. At what share it is turned into a story archive, the most tokens it may reach, and whether it compacts right away or reminds you first are all yours to set under Settings → Model → Context compaction; the model's limit is found for you, or you can enter it.
When you click Compact context you can pick the model that writes the archive, and a story too long for one model always has a way on: another model, or keeping only the last two turns.

zh.title: 立绘画得出来，也用得上了
zh.text:
画幅选竖幅就画竖幅：ComfyUI 工作流里写死了尺寸也照选的来，立绘和人设图站直了画，不再斜着挤在横图里。
卡上的 LoRA 和画风，视觉小说的立绘、人设图、表情也用上，和正文配图一个画风；在名册里换了人设图、改了长相，立绘这边马上跟着变。

en.title: Sprites you can actually use
en.text:
Pick portrait and you get portrait: even a ComfyUI workflow with its size written in follows the aspect you chose, so sprites and character pictures stand upright instead of leaning across a wide frame.
The card's LoRA and style now reach the visual novel's sprites, character pictures and expressions, matching the story's pictures; change someone's picture or looks in the cast list and their sprite follows at once.

zh.title: ComfyUI 出问题时说清楚
zh.text:
缺 LoRA 或文件、节点运行失败、显存不够、LoRA 和底模不是同一系列，都会直接告诉你原因，不再只是「画图失败」。
Flux、GGUF 这类只加载模型本体的工作流也能挂卡的 LoRA；排在别的任务后面时最多等一小时。另外，「更新了什么」改成从新到旧排。

en.title: ComfyUI says what went wrong
en.text:
A missing LoRA or file, a node that failed, running out of video memory, a LoRA from another model family: you are told why, not just "drawing failed".
Workflows that load only the diffusion model (Flux, GGUF) take the card's LoRA too, and a picture waiting behind other jobs gets an hour. Also, What's new now reads newest first.

zh.title: ComfyUI 选个模型就能画
zh.text:
画图方式选 ComfyUI 时多了「简单模式」：不用搭工作流、不用导出导入，点「读取模型」，从 ComfyUI 里装着的模型挑一个就能画。
Checkpoint（SD 1.5、SDXL、Illustrious）只选模型；Flux、Krea 2、Qwen-Image 这类扩散模型再选文本编码器和 VAE，编码器类型按文件名自动认。画幅、卡的 LoRA、立绘的设置都照样生效。

en.title: ComfyUI: pick a model and draw
en.text:
ComfyUI now has a simple mode: no workflow to build, export or import. Click Read models and pick one of the models your ComfyUI has.
A checkpoint (SD 1.5, SDXL, Illustrious) needs just the model; a diffusion model like Flux, Krea 2 or Qwen-Image also takes a text encoder and a VAE, with the encoder type worked out from the file name. Picture shape, the card's LoRA and the sprite settings all still apply.

zh.title: 导出的工作流直接能用
zh.text:
直接从 ComfyUI 导出、没写 %prompt% 的工作流，导入后也会顺着采样器找到提示词的位置，反向提示词和卡的 LoRA 也接得上。
宽高来自 Int 节点或 Resolution Selector 的工作流，选竖幅也真的画竖幅；尺寸由别的节点决定时，会告诉你该去改哪个节点。

en.title: Exported workflows just work
en.text:
A workflow exported straight from ComfyUI, with no %prompt% in it, now has its prompt found by following the samplers, and the negative and the card's LoRA go in too.
Workflows that take their size from Int nodes or a Resolution Selector draw portrait when you pick portrait; when another node decides the size, you are told which one to change.

zh.title: 立绘看得清，旧版本清得掉
zh.text:
视觉小说的「立绘」「场景」窗口里，立绘、表情和场景图点一下就放大；正在画什么、画了几秒、没画成的原因，都显示在窗口顶部，不会被窗口挡住。
应用内更新完成后，会问要不要清理旧版本的文件夹，也可以设成以后自动清理；数据目录不受影响。

en.title: Sprites up close, old versions cleared
en.text:
In the visual novel's Sprites and Scenes window, click a sprite, an expression or a scene to see it full size; what is being drawn, for how long, and why one failed now show at the top of the window instead of behind it.
After an in-app update you are asked whether to delete the old version's folders, and can have it done by itself from then on; your data folder is not touched.
